name: docusate
uses: Use for relief of occasional constipation (irregularity) this product generally produces a bowel movement in 12 to 72 hours
interactions: Drug Interaction Precaution: Do not take this product if you are presently taking mineral oil, unless directed by doctor.
otcwarn: Ask a doctor before use if you have stomach pain, nausea, or vomiting a sudden change in bowel habits that lasts over 14 days Stop use and ask a doctor if you have rectal bleeding or no bowel movement after using this product. These could be signs of a serious condition. you need to use a laxative for more than 1 week
